description: Land Acquisition - Welewatta, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District and Guruwela, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the taking possession of various land lots in Colombo District. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
